ev.q: Of the 67 influenza A (H3N2) viruses antigenically characterized, 61 (91%) were similar to A/Panama/2007/99
24 (96%) were similar to A/New Caledonia/20/99, the H1N1 component
six were from Asia, 10 were from Oceania, eight were from South America
24 (96%) were similar to A/New Caledonia/20/99, the H1N1 component
35 (95%) were similar to recommended vaccine strain B/Sichuan/379/99
Formal surveillance for influenza in the United States and reporting by CDC is conducted during October--May.

methods_quotes.q: The WHO Collaborating Center for Surveillance, Epidemiology, and Control of Influenza at CDC analyzes isolates from laboratories worldwide.
A fourfold difference in hemagglutination-inhibition titer between two viruses usually indicates antigenic variation between viruses.
